intro: With the vital role websites play in the online branding of a business, it’s no surprise how website design is currently among the highest-selling gigs in the freelancing market. Ecommerce websites, for instance, are in high demand, giving its usefulness in the selling of products and services, increasing marketing activities, and others. All this translates to higher design projects and a large clientele base for freelance website designers.

Amid the anticipation for a new website design project, one vital document you should have is your eCommerce website quotation. This document is a summary of the service you are offering your potential client and your service charges. Having this document handy and professionally crafted is an advantage for every freelance website designer.
headings: Why you must have an eCommerce website quotation
How to create an eCommerce website quotation
Factors to consider in determining your pricing
pricing: Design – What kind of page design and layout does your client want? Also, bear in mind that installing an already existing template is different from a full custom design.
Functionality – Various functions can be integrated on an eCommerce platform. Find out from your client, the functions desired. Custom functionalities should increase your service charge.
Integration – Every eCommerce website requires a payment system. Whether your client is going for ERP integration or any other third-party payment system, it should also affect the total cost.

faq.question: How do you write a quote from a website?
faq.answer: You write a quote for a website by including the costs associated with building the site (hosting, domain name, etc) and then add an itemized list of additional services like maintenance and design

faq.question: What should be included in a website quote?
faq.answer: Based on the needs of the client, the size and complexity of the website, and any additional factors. Your quotation should be carefully thought out and show clients.

faq.question: What is a quote in eCommerce?
faq.answer: In eCommerce, a price quote is a quotation sent by the seller to the customer for the provision of the good or service. Bonsai can help you send eCommerce quotes to potential customers quickly with our free templates.
